note: The manager owns this file. It is structured ON PURPOSE — the previous loop kept its state as a prose header, which degenerated into a 4,000-character run-on paragraph of abbreviations that no longer carried signal. Structure resists that.

menu.note: The menu is DATA, not prose in a skill file, so the manager can extend it (ladder rung 3). Adding a domain or a kind here is a legitimate strategic move.

kinds.name: New element
kinds.what: a thing the town did not contain

kinds.name: New CA rule
kinds.what: a new per-cell rule that makes the grid evolve

kinds.name: Deepen
kinds.what: make an existing system richer, or wire two together

kinds.name: Connect
kinds.what: link two places or systems that ignore each other

kinds.name: Polish
kinds.what: make what is there read better; add nothing

kinds.name: Interaction/UX

kinds.name: Scale/World
kinds.what: change the size, span or time of the world itself

coverage.note: domain -> kind -> iteration numbers. Pre-loop work (CHANGELOG iterations 1-31, hand-driven) is recorded as `pre` so the manager knows the ground it stands on.

inventory.note: What the town ALREADY CONTAINS, in the words a brief would use. Read by every worker before it builds. This list is the direct antidote to the previous loop's terminal failure mode: nine consecutive iterations that each surveyed the world, found everything already existed, and exited.
courtyard: walled garden with an organic bed ring
four arch entrances (two TUNNEL, two SLOT)
planting CA with 11 species and bloom stages
lane: washing lines strung over the lane
market day every 4th day with three stalls
street: cross street with two footways, roadway, curbs
allotment block with 21 plots, timber fence, gates, shed
an alley cut through the block
plaza: quay along the river with benches
life: walkers with itineraries, courtyard and street
a clock that strikes and a church bell that answers

openCues.note: The town stops changing after ~15 real minutes. maturity() caps at day 8 and richness() at day 16; at a 55 s day that is 14.7 minutes, after which every progression term is pinned at 1. There is no season and no later act. This is the rung-4 lever to reach for when rotating and deepening are spent — it would reopen the whole board.

Rain arrives out of a cloudless blue sky: skyCols() reads only hour and daylight, and the scheduler flips `raining` in a single frame. The largest surface in the frame carries the least legible system in the town.

The east third is furniture. strikeClock() rings a church bell at 9 and 18 and nothing in the world responds; updateBoat() runs a boat past a quay people already stand on and they never meet. Every eastern destination is fed by one spawnLaneAgent roll under one laneCap, so few walkers ever cross the bridge.

watch.note: The whole east half is fed by a single spawnLaneAgent roll under one laneCap. Anything you add out there competes for that one budget — check whether your feature needs its own before you conclude nobody uses it.
